scope: Read-only source/asset/dependency inventory for Ubuntu22.04 x86_64. Coverage does not imply every historical runner is portable, experimentally validated, or jointly integrated.

algorithm_groups.title: FAST-LIO2 baseline and observed LiDAR constraints
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Historical LiDAR/IMU simulation baseline, not the new joint estimator.

algorithm_groups.title: Native FAST-LIVO2 frontend/backend
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Native 19-dimensional state; fixed-map/independent-native-observation approximation is retained.

algorithm_groups.title: Actual nonlinear 28-dimensional clone/plane/raw-flow extension
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Core mathematical checks plus actual native-state replay. Full single recorded flight: 37 applied native mean/covariance changes; this is not a multiseed or AP-flight result.

algorithm_groups.title: Immutable exact-stamp input, cumulative barriers, five modes and evaluator
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Original 83.753s flight; common 28144 sensor inputs, 127 source seed opportunities, 123 completed pairs. No nearest-range restamping or truth input. Single flight does not prove statistical superiority.

algorithm_groups.title: Shared range-scale covariance mechanism
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Synthetic scalar/rate moments and Monte Carlo coverage; point estimates identical across uncertainty assumptions; not raw-image state fusion.

algorithm_groups.title: Single-window correlated Gaussian update
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Declared Gaussian mechanism with independent audit; not a live state estimator or sensor calibration.

algorithm_groups.title: Persistent nuisance and clone-state linear windows
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: 19+1+6 linear fixture and primitive-latent oracle; distinct from the nonlinear 19+6+3 production extension.

algorithm_groups.title: Ordered gyro integration and two-view geometry
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Deterministic SO(3)/gyro fixtures and earlier recorded frontend preconditions. Earlier zero-update scope is retained.

algorithm_groups.title: Downward image tracker and independent MicoLink interface
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Rendered image frontend plus protocol/PTY software tooling; no selected real camera or optical-flow hardware validation.

algorithm_groups.title: Sensor provenance/time/extrinsics contract and metadata faults
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Captured-example metadata failures do not simulate physical low texture, full sensor failure, or fused-error performance.

algorithm_groups.title: Gazebo LiDAR/IMU/front/down/range assets and bridge
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: B1 input acquisition and range-noise verification; latest B1 AP failure is not erased by replay. Range reference is evaluator-only.

algorithm_groups.title: P6 directional observed information and inflation
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Historical FAST-LIO task layer; engineered inflation is not calibrated for the new joint estimator.

algorithm_groups.title: P7 frozen training quantiles and held-out evaluation
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Train-only empirical factors on old estimator/domain; not distribution-free, arbitrary-direction, or trajectory-wide guarantees.

algorithm_groups.title: P8/P9 sampled geometry, B-spline alert limits and hard trajectory margin
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Sampled point-map hard feasibility; not continuous swept volume or guaranteed physical braking.

algorithm_groups.title: P10 finite-candidate information forecast and recovery
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Heuristic surfel forecast/discrete surrogate search; does not propagate full joint state-map correlations or prove global optimality.

algorithm_groups.title: P11/P15 map gain, collision/energy proxies and utility after hard feasibility
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Old independent simulation results and historical online-map comparisons; not jointly revalidated with raw-flow estimator.

algorithm_groups.title: Mapping/frontier and vendored EGO planner
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Contains both legacy Python proxy kernels and actual vendored ROS EGO packages; these must not be conflated.

algorithm_groups.title: P12 temporal dynamic map and braking/reopening
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Historical dynamic-obstacle simulation; commanded intervention is not instantaneous actuator stopping.

algorithm_groups.title: P13/P14 measured latency, safety envelopes, deterministic faults and FSM
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Historical online task tests plus fault-tool availability; no assertion that all those cases were rerun on the new joint estimator.

algorithm_groups.title: Clock mapping, latched guard, startup graph and FCU receipt gates
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Offline time studies and AP4.7.1 disarmed communication probes are separate evidence. No new joint estimator armed mission or hardware claim.

algorithm_groups.title: Deterministic raw-input selection/dropout transform
algorithm_groups.experimental_scope: Six profiles times five selection seeds were index-only dry-run validated. No production multi-method degradation matrix was run; same-flight phase seeds are not independent flight trials.

serial_prototype.scope: Standalone serial position baseline mathematics and synthetic covariance checks only. Not integrated in native replay; not a strong recorded-data baseline result.

math_mapping_scope: Locations document formula-to-code correspondence. The complete new estimator derivation and the historical planning appendix are distinct: no transfer of old PL calibration or joint task-layer validation is implied.

external_runtime_dependencies.bundle_policy: System dependency, not a promise of a fully offline apt mirror.

raw_replay_data.identity_origin: SHA identities copied from frozen source index; current original file sizes checked read-only. This inventory does not itself re-open SQLite or repeat original DB hashes. independent_verify_bundle.py hashes staged raw bytes without opening DB.
raw_replay_data.truth_scope: Truth and noiseless range reference are independent evaluator exports only; never fed to algorithm publisher.

portability_findings.detail: Primary research workspace has 44 missing canonical files plus 4 changed files. Stage canonical source, not the stale research src/scripts/config.
Historical shell runners hardcode research workspace and preservation/asset paths; retain for provenance, use reviewed portable launchers rather than silently rewriting protected source.

Historical replay/study tools include original canonical/archive/AP locations and some bound SHA identities; require explicit frozen-input export and a launcher/path adapter, or mark unavailable. Do not substitute current algorithms into historical results.
Frozen reference index points to original absolute DB paths. Prepare a new index for bundled raw bag; keep original acquisition/payload/source SHA identities and independent truth exports.
gpu_lidar and cameras require a render backend even with gz sim -s; EGL/Mesa llvmpipe is an existing software path, not GPU-free sensor physics or a measured server throughput guarantee.
15 ROS packages declare Apache2, BSD, GPL2 or GPL3. Preserve upstream LICENSE/PROVENANCE and notices; no single Apache license represents the whole bundle.
Range/camera/LiDAR selection profiles exist and source transforms were validated; no full multiseed degradation estimator matrix or real low-texture/nonflat-plane experiment is available.

Historical P6-P15 planning/task math is included but not jointly recalibrated/revalidated with new clone-plane-flow state. AP4.7.1 disarmed probes do not establish an armed mission with the joint estimator.

headless_example.scope: Existing documented no-AP algorithm-carrier scene, not a newly executed server test.
headless_example.command: export GZ_PARTITION=impact_server_$$_$USER; export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=llvmpipe EGL_PLATFORM=surfaceless; export GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH="$PWD/src/xq_gz_assets/models"; timeout 20s gz sim -s -r --headless-rendering --iterations 800 "$PWD/src/xq_gz_assets/worlds/xq_indoor_office.sdf"

linux_lf_identity_policy: Original bytes/SHA are retained. The sole alternate is the explicitly indexed UTF8 CRLF-to-LF export; candidate files are hashed raw, never normalized by the verifier.
